- Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field preferred.

- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and holidays.
- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100853

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows.

26WD100853, Senior Consulting Project Manager

Position Overview

Senior Consulting Project Managers deliver transformation projects for strategic Autodesk customers as part of our Customer Success Consulting team. You will manage multiple medium to large projects, or programs of work, at a time. As a Senior Consulting Project Manager, you will lead the execution and completion of all consulting services for our customers. You will ensure that projects are delivered on time, on budget and meet customer expectations. Our Project Management team is focused on world-class delivery. You will remotely join our team based in the United States reporting to one of the PM Managers.

Responsibilities

You will project manage consulting projects for Autodesk customers, including data migration projects, software development projects and software trainings
Lead internal and external team members to meet project goals
Maintain communication amongst account team and project team members, lead project review meetings
Translate project scope and vision into clear goals for the team
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, and project control tools using standard PM and PSA software
Comply with internal reporting standards and practices
You will perform project plan analysis and evaluate risk and develop risk mitigation plans
Support sales and business development by writing and/or reviewing proposals, writing scopes of work, and developing delivery estimates and resource requirements for solution
Develop strong client and stakeholder relationships and maintaining effective communication channels

Minimum Qualifications

6+ years experience as a project manager, ideally in a professional services or consulting environment
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a relevant field
PMP / PMI qualified or equivalent
Demonstrated ability to lead a team to achieve project objectives and deliver projects that ultimately go into production within cost/schedule constraints
Demonstrated ability to work in a cross-functional team of technical experts, sales, subject matter experts, and other project managers
An ability to review and write scopes of work, project-related documentation, and develop and present presentations
You demonstrate coaching and leadership skills, coupled with a collaborative and inclusive mindset

___________________________________________________________________________

Aperçu du Poste

Les chefs de projet conseil seniors mènent à bien des projets de transformation pour les clients stratégiques d’Autodesk au sein de notre équipe de conseil dédiée à la réussite client. Vous gérerez simultanément plusieurs projets de taille moyenne à grande, ou programmes de travail. En tant que chef de projet senior en conseil, vous dirigerez l'exécution et la réalisation de l'ensemble des services de conseil destinés à nos clients. Vous veillerez à ce que les projets soient livrés dans les délais, dans le respect du budget et conformément aux attentes des clients. Notre équipe de gestion de projet a pour objectif d'offrir une prestation de classe mondiale. Vous rejoindrez à distance notre équipe basée aux États-Unis et rendrez compte à l'un des responsables de la gestion de projet.

Responsabilités

Vous assurerez la gestion de projets de conseil pour les clients d’Autodesk, notamment des projets de migration de données, de développement logiciel et de formation aux logiciels
Diriger les membres des équipes internes et externes afin d’atteindre les objectifs du projet
Assurer la communication entre les membres de l’équipe chargée du compte et ceux de l’équipe de projet, et animer les réunions de revue de projet
Traduire la portée et la vision du projet en objectifs clairs pour l’équipe
Élaborer et tenir à jour les plans de projet, les calendriers et les outils de contrôle de projet à l’aide de logiciels standard de gestion de projet (PM) et de gestion des services professionnels (PSA)
Respecter les normes et pratiques internes en matière de reporting
Vous réaliserez l’analyse des plans de projet, évaluerez les risques et élaborerez des plans d’atténuation des risques
Vous soutiendrez les équipes commerciales et de développement d’activité en rédigeant et/ou en révisant des propositions, en définissant les périmètres de travail, et en établissant des estimations de livraison et les besoins en ressources pour les solutions
Vous développerez des relations solides avec les clients et les parties prenantes et maintiendrez des canaux de communication efficaces

Qualifications Minimales

Au moins 6 ans d’expérience en tant que chef de projet, idéalement dans un environnement de services professionnels ou de conseil
Licence ou expérience professionnelle équivalente dans un domaine pertinent
Certification PMP / PMI ou équivalent
Capacité avérée à diriger une équipe pour atteindre les objectifs d’un projet et mener à bien des projets qui aboutissent à une mise en production dans le respect des contraintes de coûts et de délais
Capacité avérée à travailler au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée d’experts techniques, de commerciaux, d’experts métier et d’autres chefs de projet
Capacité à réviser et à rédiger des cahiers des charges, de la documentation liée aux projets, ainsi qu’à élaborer et à présenter des exposés

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

What You Will Do

The Transition Project Manager
position leads a multifunctional project team to develop and execute Electric Power Systems product transfer projects utilizing the Collins Aerospace work transfer process defined in COL-PRO-0008. Transfer projects are typically between Collins Aerospace manufacturing sites (i.e. Make-to-Make) but can also be product insourcing and/or outsourcing projects (i.e. Buy-to-Make or Make-to-Buy). The Transition Project Manager will:

Lead a multifunctional project team to develop and execute product transition plans
Represent EPS business in transition risk assessments and gate reviews
Construct business cases for new product transfers
Track and report product transfer tasks including budget, schedule, risk mitigations and key actions to leadership
Work with project team to develop and deploy contingency plans and mitigation options for transition acceleration and / or recovery

Qualifications You Must Have

Typically requires a University Degree and minimum 8 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 5 years of experience
Must be a U.S. Citizen

Qualifications We Prefer

5+ years experience in Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or Engineering
Aerospace product experience, EPS product experience is preferred
Procurement/Supply Chain experience with EPS product knowledge is preferred
CORE Apprentice is preferred
Project management experience, including risk, schedule, and budget management
SAP and / or material planning experience a plus

What We Offer

Some of our competitive benefits package includes: 

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
Tuition reimbursement program
Student Loan Repayment Program
Life insurance and disability coverage
Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
Adoption Assistance
Autism Benefit
Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
And more!

Learn More & Apply Now!

Operations, Supply Chain and EH&S:

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

Collins Aerospace, a RTX company, is a leader in technologically advanced and intelligent solutions for the global aerospace and defense industry. Collins Aerospace has the capabilities, comprehensive portfolio and expertise to solve customers’ toughest challenges and to meet the demands of a rapidly evolving global market.

WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE.

Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.

Remote
: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). An employee may be expected to travel to the site location as needed.

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibility. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other -- propel us all higher, again and again.

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day!

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 107,500 USD - 204,500 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.

Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.

This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.

RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. jobs.title: Associate Project Manager, Permitting [Nevada]
jobs.description:
About Pulley

Pulley helps the country’s top architects, builders, and retailers speed up every project in their portfolio. With AI-powered permitting intelligence and expert guidance, we eliminate costly delays and bring predictability across the full lifecycle of commercial projects.

Today, permitting is the slowest, most uncertain part of building, spread across 19,000+ jurisdictions with different rules, timelines, and surprises. Pulley gives project teams the clarity and predictability they need to move from planning to opening without delays.

We support rollout programs for brands like J.Crew, Solidcore, and Hibbett Sports, as well as major data center buildouts, EV charging networks, and other commercial projects. Our platform dramatically reduces approval timelines, improves forecasting accuracy, and removes thousands of hours of manual work from design and construction teams.

Founded in 2021, Pulley combines deep permitting expertise with purpose-built AI from people who have created products used by millions. We’re backed by CRV, Susa Ventures, Fifth Wall, and leaders from Plaid, Segment, ServiceTitan, and Procore.

The Role

You must be located in Nevada to be considered for this role.

Role

Our in-house permitting team is a key function for driving fast, reliable permitting outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will:

Support our lead project managers in delivering great permitting outcomes for customers
Help conduct permit research with a high degree of accuracy
Assist in preparing permit plans
Collaborate with city staff on nuances and ambiguities
Monitor permit status and ensure timely responses
Provide feedback to product & engineering teams to help refine our software platform
Work with permitting leadership to refine our standard operating procedures

Who You Are

To be successful in this role, you are likely someone with:

2+ years in either construction management or architecture, with a focus on project management
Experience applying for and obtaining construction permits
Ability to research permit requirements with accuracy
Comfortable interfacing city staff and navigating administrative processes
Clear communicator with a strong attention to detail
Proactive problem solver

jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - Commissioning
jobs.description:
About EEI

Engineering Economics, Inc. (EEI) is a recognized leader in facility and energy consulting. We deliver innovative, performance-focused solutions that maximize building performance, extend system lifecycles, and reduce utility costs. This dedication has earned us trusted partnerships with Fortune 500 organizations, national healthcare networks, prestigious universities, and leading government agencies.

Nationally recognized for building commissioning and building performance, EEI also provides facility assessments, master planning, energy audits, and technical program management, supported by specialty teams serving healthcare, data, and mission-critical facilities.

Our reputation is built by the people who lead our work every day. That’s why our values aren’t just words, they are lived out daily in how we make decisions, build trusted relationships, and deliver quality. As an employee-owned company, we share success through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), reflecting our commitment to building something meaningful together. And as EEI rapidly grows, we’re looking for talented people who want meaningful work, a supportive team, and room to grow.

Learn more at https://eeibuildingperformance.com/

Position Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to oversee and manage the commissioning process for our projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that systems, components, and equipment are installed, tested, and operated according to the project requirements, industry standards, and client expectations.

What sets EEI apart as a place to grow, contribute, and enjoy professional satisfaction?

Individual autonomy within a collaborative team structure
High-profile clients who appreciate what we do
Cooperative teams that emphasize mutual respect, trust, and accountability
Hard-working colleagues who are passionate about solving problems and delivering value to our clients
Attractive compensation packages with competitive base compensation, performance bonuses, and exceptional employee benefits, including an Employee Stock Ownership Program

Job Requirements:

Develop and implement commissioning plans and schedules for projects.
Coordinate with project stakeholders, including clients, contractors, and internal teams.
Witness pre-functional and conduct functional testing of systems and equipment.
Identify and resolve issues during the commissioning process.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, codes, and regulations.
Prepare commissioning reports and documentation.
Provide training and support to clients and end-users.

Exceptional stakeholder‑management and communication skills, with experience serving as the primary client interface and representing the project with partners, contractors, and regulatory agencies.
Collaborative working style, with the ability to build and maintain effective relationships with engineering, construction, project controls, commercial teams, and external vendors.

Title:
Program Manager

Company:
Global Power Components – www.globalpowercomponents.com

Location:
Milwaukee, WI (onsite 5-days/week)

Direct Hire

Position Summary

Global Power Components is seeking an experienced Program Manager to oversee large customer programs and strategic accounts within our engineer-to-order (ETO) manufacturing business. This role serves as the senior point of contact for complex projects and key customers while providing leadership and guidance to Project Managers responsible for daily project execution. The Program Manager is responsible for managing customer relationships, overseeing multiple related projects, supporting commercial and operational decision-making, and ensuring successful execution of large-scale manufacturing programs from quotation through final delivery. This position bridges Sales, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Project Management to ensure customer objectives, project milestones, and business goals remain aligned. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in manufacturing, engineering, industrial construction, power systems, fabrication, or custom equipment projects and be comfortable managing executive-level customer relationships while driving internal accountability and performance.

Core Responsibilities

Program & Account Management

Serve as the primary relationship manager for strategic customers and large multi-project accounts.
Oversee multiple active projects within assigned customer programs.
Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships while serving as the primary escalation point.
Lead regular customer meetings, project reviews, business updates, and schedule discussions.
Manage customer expectations regarding schedules, scope changes, manufacturing constraints, and delivery commitments.
Identify opportunities for additional business, repeat orders, and program growth.

Project Management Leadership

Provide guidance, support, and oversight to Project Managers assigned to customer programs.
Ensure projects are properly planned, executed, and communicated throughout the organization.
Assist Project Managers with schedule conflicts, change orders, customer escalations, and production challenges.
Review project status reports, milestones, risks, and recovery plans.
Promote standardization and best practices across project management activities.

Commercial & Financial Oversight

Support Sales and Estimating teams during project handoff and contract review processes.
Review pricing assumptions, scope changes, and customer change orders throughout project lifecycles.
Monitor program profitability, budget performance, and project financial metrics.
Evaluate business risks and assist leadership with strategic decision-making.
Participate in forecasting, backlog reviews, and customer demand planning activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate activities between Sales, Engineering, Purchasing, Production, Quality, Logistics, and Project Management teams.
Drive resolution of issues impacting project schedules, customer commitments, or operational performance.
Lead internal program reviews and ensure alignment between departments.
Facilitate communication regarding production priorities, resource planning, and customer expectations.

Schedule & Execution Management

Monitor schedules across multiple projects and customer programs.
Identify risks to project timelines and proactively implement recovery plans.
Review long-lead materials, critical path items, and production constraints.
Ensure customer commitments are aligned with manufacturing capacity and business objectives.
Maintain visibility into project milestones and program-level deliverables.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Develop and track key program-level metrics including: On-time delivery, Customer satisfaction, Program profitability, Project cycle times, Backlog performance, Change order activity, Forecast accuracy, Resource utilization
Analyze performance trends and implement corrective actions when necessary.
Drive process improvements that improve scalability, customer service, and operational efficiency.

Required

7+ years of experience in project management, program management, engineering, manufacturing, industrial construction, fabrication, or related technical environments.
Experience managing large customer accounts and highly complex projects.
Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, engineer-to-order project execution, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence organizational priorities.
Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
Strong financial, scheduling, and analytical capabilities.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

Experience managing strategic accounts in power systems, industrial equipment, fabrication, construction, or manufacturing industries.
PMP certification or advanced project/program management training.
Experience with contract management, commercial negotiations, and customer escalations.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Manufacturing, or a related field.
Experience with ERP systems, Smartsheet, and project management software.

Smartsheet, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Microsoft Outlook, ERP Systems, CRM Platforms, Project Tracking & Reporting Tools

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Electrodes
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

The Electrode Engineering teams within the Core Technology group at Form Energy are multidisciplinary and focused on delivering qualified battery anode and cathode designs that meet operational performance targets, at cost and with high reliability, from controlled processes on high-volume manufacturing lines for Form Energy's utility-scale multi-day energy storage system.

Electrode Engineering is hiring a Senior Program Manager, to lead program management efforts for the development of our Iron-Air battery products. As part of our Core Technology Team, you will contribute to bringing our anode and cathode designs into production, through supporting the activities of our mechanical engineering, materials engineering, and battery engineering teams. As a coordinator and communicator, you will drive tracking and reporting of top risks. You will also take tactical ownership of our product design and execution schedule, through prototyping and engineering validation phases – tracking milestones from design release through supplier fabrication and landing at our factory. This will involve close communication with our factory production and operations teams, supply chain, and various design engineers, as well as coordination with other program managers across the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape and be part of the growth of a fast-moving company with breakthrough technology and an incredible mission! If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, apply now!

What You'll Do

Drive electrode programs from the prototyping phase into mass production, while managing and communicating schedules across multiple teams to ensure efficient alignment, coordination, and execution
Maintain design release schedules from design reviews through to landing materials, for externally sourced components
Coordinate with supply chain partners on procurement of tools, critical active materials, and components
Organize and provide routine updates on top technical and program risks and issues, communicating key programmatic information inward to the Electrode Engineering organization, and outward to the broader engineering organization.
Improve our program management systems and structures based on best-practices and your personal experience, to effectively integrate with and support Form Energy’s world-class technical team
Proactively identify and frame key decisions and risks, and work with stakeholders to develop decision-quality options; facilitate progress by ensuring appropriate scheduling, resourcing, and prioritization of engineering workflows

What You'll Bring

5+ years of experience in an engineering or technical Program Management role
Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, such as mechanical, materials, chemical, or electrical engineering
Demonstrated experience in hardware R&D programs
Demonstrated experience with contract manufacturers and/or suppliers of high-volume custom components
Excellent communication and organizational skills, ability to communicate & present at all levels
Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously
A growth mindset and bias for action: you treat ambiguity and roadblocks as opportunities to drive progress, not reasons to wait for direction, and you bring real urgency to creating impact

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never
solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

Our vision is a world where every student—regardless of background, zip code, or life circumstance—has the opportunity to succeed academically, thrive personally, and realize their full potential. Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.
Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive builds technology to improve the safety, productivity, and profitability of the physical economy. The Platform Services Organization
serves as the backbone of Motive’s engineering operations, delivering foundational infrastructure, developer ecosystem tooling, cloud operations, SRE reliability, data pipelines, and core services capabilities.

As Motive scales, our platform architecture requires unified, company-wide execution across horizontal initiatives. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to join as a strategic operational leader. Reporting directly to the VP of Platform Services
, this role will drive high-impact, cross-cutting technical programs that span across Motive’s entire product and engineering organization.

Position Overview

As a Technical Program Manager at Motive, you will lead complex, high-impact programs that strengthen our platform foundations and improve how engineering teams deliver at scale. This role is ideal for someone who brings strong technical judgment, structured program leadership, and the ability to create clarity across ambiguity, dependencies, and competing priorities. You will report into VP, Platform Services Engineering.

You will work across multiple engineering teams and partner functions to drive planning, execution, risk management, and operations.. You will help align teams around clear outcomes, improve execution across interdependent roadmaps, and raise the bar for how Motive delivers cross-functional platform initiatives. You will not be managing day-to-day sprint boards or acting as an administrative taskmaster. Instead, you will act as a cross-functional orchestrator - driving platform adoption, unblocking architectural shifts, and aligning multi-team investments across all of Motive.

Partner directly with the VP of Platform Services and Engineering Managers to translate organizational priorities into clear, executable program roadmaps with measurable business outcomes.
Lead end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional technical programs across Platform Services Engineering, from definition and planning through delivery and adoption.
Drive alignment across engineering and partner teams by managing goals, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and execution risks with clear operating rhythms.
Build scalable program mechanisms, including roadmap reviews, status reporting, escalation paths, and success metrics that improve visibility and accountability.
Identify systemic issues and execution gaps early, and lead teams toward practical, durable solutions that support departmental and functional objectives.
Influence technical and business stakeholders at multiple levels to make informed tradeoff decisions and keep strategic initiatives moving forward.
Mentor others through strong program management practices and help elevate execution standards across the broader engineering organization.
Drive Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews, executive reporting, and cross-organizational communications to align executive leadership, product partners, and engineering leads.
Collaborate with Product leadership on mapping the product roadmap into programs that interface with multiple product engineering teams.
Implement dynamic program tracking frameworks (e.g., Gantt / single-source-of-truth models) that flag delivery risks weeks in advance.

Required Qualifications & Experience

7+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a related role within software, infrastructure, or platform organizations.
Proven track record leading large, ambiguous, multi-team programs with significant cross-functional dependencies and measurable business or platform impact.
Strong technical fluency and the ability to engage credibly with engineering leaders and teams on architecture, trade offs, delivery risks, and execution plans.
Demonstrated strength in structuring programs, driving decision-making, and solving complex problems in fast-paced, evolving environments.
Experience building alignment across senior stakeholders and improving communication, governance, and execution across interdependent teams.
Outcome-Oriented Focus:
Demonstrated bias for action and root-cause problem solving over administrative tracking; experience moving beyond Jira hygiene to actively unblocking delivery.
Executive Communication:
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to synthesize technical complexities into clear executive summaries and trade-off matrices.
Data-Driven Approach:
Expertise in establishing objective metrics (MetricSense, Datadog dashboards, SLO attainment, cost trends) to govern program success.

jobs.description:
Job Title:
Senior Technical Program Manager

Job Type:
Full-time

Job Location:
Boston, MA

Reports to:
Vice President of Quantum Computing Services

Summary

QuEra is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead program management activities around product and service delivery of QuEra’s quantum computers, starting with Aquila and Gemini, and extending to future generations of QuEra systems.

This role is execution-oriented and inherently cross-functional, coordinating work across hardware and software engineering, research and operations. The role includes limited product management responsibilities, scoped to requirements collection and feedback, and is expected to work collaboratively with future dedicated product management hires.

This role is designed to fulfill these goals, and to evolve as the company grows and the needs change:

Ensure reliable delivery and operation of gate-based quantum computers,
Establish a structured feedback loop from customers and users back into engineering, and align customer projects for success,
Support the product development work on QuEra’s systems towards industrial-grade, TRL=9 platforms, through disciplined program execution,
Enable progress tracking and transparent communication across all stakeholders.

Year 1 focus

The main focus in year 1 will be to support the success of QuEra’s overall AIST program which consists of 4 threads centered around our first gate-based system Gemini:

[Product] Launching two product lines on top of the on-prem Gemini machine at AIST: Gemini-QEC, a platform for error correction researchers, and Gemini-NISQ, a platform for NISQ-era application developers. Initial product launches will be followed by planned upgrades and feature releases in quick succession.
[Customers & Projects] Enabling the success of concrete customers and customer projects on the Gemini machine at AIST, which divide into preview projects (leading up to each product/feature release and leveraging close collaboration with the machine team), and GA projects (following each product/feature release and utilizing the generally available capabilities). Customer success in this context will depend on a fine balance of customer experience, data quality, and timely execution of project phases.
[Integration] Completing system integration with access/distribution partners, in two modalities: HPC integration, and cloud integration.
[Development] Achieving milestones in the NEDO program focused on developing the hardware and software systems towards industrial-grade quantum computers by 2030. This development work is not independent of, but rather on the critical path for 1-3.

Key responsibilities

Product:
Translate high-level product goals and technical roadmap into executable plans, milestones, and dependencies.
Track risks, schedules, and cross-team deliverables to ensure on-time, high-quality product launches.
Customers and Projects
Act as the program coordination point for customer co-design and onboarding efforts.
Ensure customer expectations, constraints, and feedback are clearly communicated and tracked.
Support technical teams by managing structure, timelines, and communication.
Integration
Act as the program coordination point for integration activities, including alignment efforts and end-to-end tests.
Collect and synthesize requirements from integration partners and stakeholders, spanning functional and non-functional requirements (e.g. API payload vs API security).
Development
Align timelines, requirements and dependencies, with awareness of product, business and operational constraints.
Track progress and support documentation efforts.
Support reporting efforts for external stakeholders (e.g. NEDO program management).
Contribute to QuEra’s readiness for scaling gate-based quantum computing beyond Gemini, including operational and organizational considerations.

To achieve a balanced success in 1-4 above, the role will take responsibility for managing machine time across activities, machine use agreements, and regulatory requirements (e.g. data privacy, network security, etc.).

Qualification & Profile

Required:

Engineering background (e.g., semiconductor, systems engineering, advanced computing infrastructure).
Experience in technical program management, system delivery, or execution of complex technical products.
Strong ability to coordinate across multiple teams and external stakeholders.
Comfort in customer-facing, execution-oriented roles.
Strong communication, documentation, and organizational skills.

Preferred:

Experience with on-premise deployments and security/network-constrained environments.
Exposure to quantum computing, HPC, or advanced computing platforms.
Experience working with government, national lab, or research customers.
Demonstrated ability to learn new technical domains quickly.

As part of the Global Technical Program Management team, you will regularly engage with Intellian's customers to provide program updates in accordance with partnership and contractual commitments. This role involves leading the successful delivery of Gateway Antenna product offerings, working collaboratively with internal teams, suppliers, engineering teams, and customers in a fast-paced, analytical environment, while driving productization from concept through mass production.

Create and maintain management weekly reports and dashboards.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Program Manager, Technology – Software Asset Management (SAM) will be leading High-Impact, High-Risk Programs that enable SAM transformation. The role drives SAM programs that leverages FlexeraOne, automation, and generative-AI workflows to manage the end-to-end software lifecycle at Nordstrom. Success demands deep licensing expertise, data-driven storytelling, and cross-functional leadership, with automation regarded as the default approach for delivering value across Nordstrom’s technology portfolio. This role understands and partners within and outside of Technology to strike the appropriate balance between solution and license risk management. This role requires a blend of advanced program management skills, strategic leadership, and technical understanding to deliver high-impact SAM programs that align with organizational goals that optimize software spend, enhance compliance and risk management, and drive measurable business value. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of delivering large-scale programs on time and within budget, leveraging automation and AI-driven analytics to improve processes. They will also excel in stakeholder engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring teams to build organizational SAM maturity.

A day in the life…

Program Governance: Lead and oversee strategic SAM initiatives with broad organizational impact, high risk compliance programs and enterprise-impacting process improvements.
Strategic Approach: Ensure programs are aligned with enterprise objectives, including cost containment, compliance readiness, operational efficiency, and deliver measurable outcomes.
AI & Automation Oversight: Incorporate AI and automation technologies into SAM processes to enhance SAM operations, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy across license management and compliance reporting.
Stakeholder Engagement and Influence: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Vendor Management, Sourcing, Security, Engineering, Legal, and Tech Finance to drive a unified license-compliance process. Facilitate executive-level meetings, such as Steering Committees to provide data-driven insights on program progress, license risk, and outcomes, enabling informed decision-making. Build strong relationships with stakeholders, proactively influencing priorities and resolving conflicts to align diverse perspectives with organizational goals.
Program and Team Leadership: Provide strategic data and process insights to cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity of roles, responsibilities, and understanding of deliverables for SAM programs. Mentor and develop team members, fostering a collaborative and solution-driven culture while building the next generation of SAM expertise. Drive projects across multiple SAM initiatives, ensuring consistency with enterprise strategies and IT asset management objectives.
Data-Driven Program Management: Identify gaps in operational Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of SAM programs, including cost savings, compliance adherence, and license optimization, and proposes solutions to leadership. Leverage AI-driven analytics and reporting tools to monitor progress, identify and mitigate risks, and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
Continuous SAM Development: Champion innovation with SAM by identifying opportunities to enhance tools, processes, and data integration to meet evolving business needs. Establish knowledge-sharing frameworks, such as playbooks, templates, and best practices, to scale SAM capabilities across organization. Act as a thought leader in SAM, inspiring teams to adopt proactive, AI-enabled, and results-driven approaches to program delivery.

Expert knowledge of FlexeraOne, including foundational back-end knowledge
Familiarity with major software vendors both on-prem and cloud (e.g. Oracle, Google, Azure, AWS) to ensure compliance and cost optimization.
Proven ability to manage software audits and ensure audit readiness
Executive stakeholder management – able to brief VP/CTO level, ability to be a strategic storyteller and distill complex data into action-oriented exec narratives
Ability to inspire others, engage in healthy debate, including demonstrated experience leading strong teams and be a change catalyst that rallies diverse teams around new tooling and processes
Technical background and understanding of both core infrastructure and software development principals 
Ability to build relationships cross-functionally with multiple teams both within and outside of technology from areas such as Vendor Management, Security, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Strategic Sourcing and Procurement, and HR
Strong leadership skills to foster collaboration among cross-functional teams and drive alignment on SAM priorities
Track record of AI/automation enablement (e.g. Azure OpenAI, GitHub Actions, Power Automate) to optimize SAM processes and uncover actional insights, and how to implement automation workflows that reduce manual effort and enhance accuracy in reporting
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data and provide clear, actionable recommendations
Proficiency in defining and tracking metrics to measure program success and continuously improve SAM processes
Ability to align SAM initiatives with broader organizational goals, such as cost containment, compliance, and digital transformation
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Proven ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, including executives, IT leaders, and business unit managers – answer the question “Why should this license risk be prioritized?”

jobs.description:
Not just a job, but a career

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

About The Team

Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

Yokogawa is on the move, transforming itself from Industrial Automation to Industrial Autonomy (IA2IA) provider with advanced technologies allowing devices, equipment, business and production systems or even entire plants to operate autonomously. We were the world’s first company to develop a distributed process control system for the monitoring and control of various types of plant facilities, and we continue to evolve to meet our customer demanding needs. To help its customers keep pace with rapid advances in technology and an ever-changing business environment, Yokogawa provides solutions and services that will enable a digital transformation (DX) in their businesses, and is preparing the way for a future in which industries will make the transition from IA2IA. Bring your whole self to work each day and realize your greatest potential by enabling our customers to achieve world-class operational excellence! Join the transformation!

Job Summary

The Senior Program/Project Manager – SAP S/4HANA Upgrade (North America) is responsible for leading the North American workstream of a global SAP ECC-to-SAP S/4HANA transformation, with a planned go-live in 2028.

While the overall program is led by the global IT organization, this role owns planning and execution for the North American region, including implementation activities, local add-ons and integrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), training programs, change management, communications, and stakeholder alignment across all North American businesses and functions.

The role is aimed at a highly experienced SAP program/project manager with a strong track record in large, complex, multi-year SAP implementations and upgrades, particularly SAP S/4HANA.

Duties/Results

Act as the primary North American program/project lead within the global SAP S/4HANA program governance structure.
Develop and maintain the regional project plan (scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, resources, budget) aligned with global standards and methodologies (e.g., SAP Activate / PMO framework).
Ensure consistency with global design principles while representing North American regulatory, legal, tax, and business requirements.
Coordinate with global IT, regional IT, business process owners, and external partners/consultants.
Provide regular status reporting, risk/issue escalation, and decision-ready recommendations to regional leadership and the global program steering committee.
Lead all North American implementation activities across requirements, solution design, build, testing, data migration, cutover planning, and post-go-live hypercare.
Manage local add-on developments, interfaces, and integrations required to support regional business processes and legacy systems.
Coordinate and oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across all impacted business units, including test planning, test case definition, execution, defect management, and sign-off.
Define target user groups and role-based training needs in collaboration with business process owners and functional leads.
Oversee development of training content (classroom, virtual, e-learning, job aids) and ensure timely, high-quality training delivery to end users and key stakeholders.
Serve as a visible change champion, ensuring consistent messaging and engagement from leadership across the region.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across all North American business units, functions, and sites.
Proactively identify, assess, and manage program and project risks, issues, and dependencies; drive mitigation and contingency plans and ensure clear ownership.
Ensure adherence to global program standards, architecture principles, security and compliance requirements, and internal controls.
Monitor quality of deliverables from all internal and external teams; ensure that testing and validation processes meet agreed criteria before moving to subsequent phases.
Lead the regional hypercare phase after go-live, coordinating incident resolution, enhancement requests, and user support.
Capture lessons learned and improvement opportunities from North America and feed them back into global continuous improvement initiatives.
Support the transition from project mode to “business-as-usual” operations in collaboration with global IT, Shared Services, and business process owners.

Specifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, Engineering, or related field (Master’s degree preferred)
10–15+ years of overall IT project/program management experience, with a significant portion in ERP/SAP initiatives
Minimum 3–5 full life-cycle SAP implementations, including at least one large SAP S/4HANA program or ECC-to-S/4HANA conversion in a global or multi-region context
Proven experience managing large, cross-functional teams (IT, business, external partners) in a matrixed, international environment
Demonstrated success leading complex change and user adoption (training programs, communication strategies, stakeholder engagement).
Strong understanding of core SAP processes (e.g., Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, Manufacturing/Logistics) and how they are impacted by S/4HANA
Professional certifications such as PMP, Prince2, or Scrum/Agile; SAP S/4HANA or SAP project management certifications are a plus.

The ideal candidate demonstrates advanced expertise across all aspects of the delivery process, deep knowledge of regulatory standards for deploying systems in commercial/industrial environments, and proven capability in guiding cross-functional teams.

As a Senior Staff Project Manager, you will independently lead high-impact, high-complexity customer programs, managing overarching project timelines, resource strategy, and financial tracking with minimal supervision. While driving complex project requirements, you will serve as a lead point of contact for key customer executives and project leaders, guide Boston Dynamics’ world-class Field Applications Engineering teams, and manage key third-party vendors and subcontractors to ensure flawless execution.

To succeed in this role, you must bring strong technical fluency across hardware, software, and systems engineering, excel at navigating high levels of ambiguity, and demonstrate a track record of shaping project delivery models. This strategic role offers growth paths into senior leadership within engineering program management, general management, or business strategy.

Demonstrations & Pilots: Oversee logistics, strategy, and execution for high-profile customer pilot projects, field demonstrations, and trade show interactions.
Mentorship & Capability Building: Mentor junior project team members and contribute to scaling organizational project and program management capabilities.

Execution: Analyzes and prioritizes the varying aspects of the role, knows and/or follows the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, and consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances.
Collaboration: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives through effective communication that understands the unique needs of different audiences.
Innovation: Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful, anticipates and adopts innovations in business, operations, and technology applications.
Adaptability: Adapts and pivots in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations, and moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change and ambiguity.

You Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Robotics, Mechanical, Electrical, Systems Engineering) or a related technical field (Master’s preferred).
6+ years of progressive experience in technical project/program management, with direct leadership in fast-paced technology integration, robotics, or complex electromechanical system deployments.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Professional Project Management certification (PMP, Agile, or equivalent).

Mastery of testing, manufacturing, commissioning, and quality control processes in commercial/industrial environments.

Demonstrated ability to build structure out of ambiguity and drive process development where formal frameworks do not yet exist.

jobs.title: Production Program Manager, Space
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril’s Space Manufacturing team is seeking a Production Program Manager to join our team. The Space Manufacturing team is responsible for the assembly, integration and test of complete space vehicles across multiple concurrent product lines, and for the manufacturing engineering, test operations and tooling that make those builds repeatable at rate. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability at Anduril.

As a Production Program Manager, you will be a program leader responsible for planning, directing, and measuring the seamless execution and integration of the production work stream across multiple functions, including manufacturing engineering, supply chain, Quality, test, and design engineering. You will lead initiatives in collaboration with Business Line and Manufacturing Engineering to define, deploy, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across these functions during New Product Introduction, Limited Rate and Full Rate Production phases. These KPIs will span schedule, cost, risk management, product maturation, and resource utilization, in accordance with Anduril’s Manufacturing Development Process (MDP). You'll also own the manufacturing and Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) execution plan — schedule, risk, KPIs and gate readiness. It does not own the engineering work itself; manufacturing engineering, test operations and quality are owned by their respective leads.

What You’ll Do

Partner with planning, production, manufacturing engineering, design engineering, supply chain, quality, launch operations and business line leadership on strategic priorities and delivery commitments.
Own the integrated manufacturing and AIT schedule across multiple product lines: build it, maintain it as the schedule of record, and run the critical path and execution-risk analysis leadership decides from.
Drive execution against that schedule week to week: convene the cross-functional cadence, hold owners to dates, surface slips early with quantified impact, and drive recovery plans rather than reporting variance after the fact.
Define, deploy and monitor manufacturing KPIs from New Product Introduction through full rate production per Anduril's Manufacturing Development Process, and build the gate-readiness and critical-path reporting leadership acts on.
Build and maintain the production cost model with Sourcing, Manufacturing Engineering and Finance. This model is the principal basis for strategic decisions on production design, operations and resource allocation.
Serve as the manufacturing and AIT counterpart to the program managers and chief engineers, carrying delegated authority from the Director of Manufacturing to conduct manufacturing and AIT gates.
Own manufacturing and AIT risk: maintain the risk register, quantify schedule and cost exposure, drive mitigation to closure, and make the trade between accepting risk and holding a gate explicit rather than implicit.
Integrate the manufacturing engineering, test operations and MEP process steps into the program plan and capture that scope correctly within NRE so the work is funded rather than absorbed.
Represent production up and out: contribute proposal and Basis of Estimate content for manufacturing and AIT scope, present at milestone reviews, and brief customers and business line leadership on execution status, gate readiness and risk.
Engage principal vendors and partners alongside Sourcing to hold delivery commitments and contract compliance and integrate their milestones into the schedule as dependencies with real dates.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline.
8+ years in program, project or production management in aerospace, space, defense or another complex hardware industry.
3+ years owning schedule and execution for a hardware program.
Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.
Has personally owned an integrated master schedule as the schedule of record — built the network, maintained it, ran critical path — with network-level fluency in Microsoft Project, Primavera P6 or Smartsheet: logic, float, resource loading and baselines.
Experience managing a program through a New Product Introduction transition into rate production, with the readiness gates and reviews that go with it (PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR, PRR or equivalents).
Has held a date or a gate against pressure from a peer organization and can describe how it was resolved. This role fails without it.
Demonstrated risk and performance management on a hardware program: a maintained risk register with quantified exposure and mitigations driven to closure, plus KPIs that changed a decision where you can explain the mechanism.
Has represented a production or program organization up and out: contributed proposal and Basis of Estimate content, and briefed customers or executive leadership on status, readiness and risk. Both the written and the in-person sides matter here.
Has built or owned a production cost model — unit cost, labor content, material cost, NRE versus recurring — and used it to drive a decision on capacity, make/buy or resource allocation.
Spacecraft or satellite program experience, including integration and test campaign scheduling and environmental test sequencing.
Took a hardware program from single-digit annual builds into rate production of 100+ units per year.
Earned value management or control account ownership, and experience capturing manufacturing scope correctly within NRE.
Managed supplier and partner delivery commitments alongside Sourcing, including contract compliance and recovery on a late supplier.
PMP, Agile, Lean or Six Sigma credentials, and working fluency in Jira, Confluence and Smartsheet.

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

The Third-Party Security Manager is responsible for leading and maturing the organization's Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program. This role oversees the identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks associated with vendors, suppliers, service providers, business partners, and other third parties. The position works closely with Information Security, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, Privacy, Enterprise Risk Management, and business stakeholders to ensure third-party relationships align with organizational risk tolerance, regulatory requirements, and security standards. Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and industry frameworks including NIST, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FFIEC, GLBA, PCI-DSS, and applicable privacy regulations.

Maintain a compliant Quality Assurance Program, ensure proper maintenance documentation, and enforce FAA/NAVAIR standards for airworthiness.

Overview

Project Manager-Information Services Senior

Our leaders shape strategic initiatives, develop enthusiastic teams, and work to improve health outcomes. They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork, and purpose in all that they do .
Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our Information Services team in the role of Project Manager-Information Services Senior.

Summary

The Field Project Manager (FPM) serves as the Information Services (IS) representative within the construction environment for Strategic Projects. This role builds and maintains strong partnerships with Design & Construction (D&C), low voltage vendors, trade partners, and the Strategic Project Manager (SPM) to ensure IS requirements are executed accurately and on schedule.

While the SPM focuses broadly across IS, Operations, and Clinical domains, the FPM is dedicated to ensuring the construction team implements IS design intent, standards, and installation quality in real time. The FPM acts as an on-site resource, liaison, and validator throughout the construction lifecycle.

Leads and directs high-priority and complex project(s) usually encompassing multiple applications and business areas to successful and timely completion and within budget. This role involves coordinating with multiple teams and governance groups. Provides administrative decision making, leadership and planning for IU Health's business and clinical projects. Assures day-to-day coordination, communications, issue/resolution, and financial management related to the assigned projects. Oversees resources assigned to the project must be familiar with the systems scope and project objectives, as well as the role and function of each team member to effectively coordinate the activities of the team. Facilitates current and future state business processes, requirements, elicitation, solutions and development and test management.

Candidate Qualifications

Candidates for the position will be evaluated according to the following criteria and competencies.

Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience.
5-7 years of relevant experience.
PMP (Project Management Process) certification is required or requirement to attain within 12 months.
Required experience with enterprise PPM (Project and Portfolio Management) tools.
Strong working skills with MS Office tools such as MS Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Vizio etc. is required.
Required experience with contractor and vendor management.
Requires a demonstrated fundamental understanding of project accounting and financial management.
Requires an understanding of the Information Management principles, IT processes, Project Management Methodologies, architecture and technologies adopted by an organization.
Experience in solution scoping, business case development and creation of TCO models is required

Connect to Promise -
Demonstrates a commitment to IU Health's mission, vision, and values by exhibiting behaviors and delivering results that align with the strategic direction of the organization. Ensure IU Health is working toward its vision of improving the health of all Hoosiers by providing the best care for each person as we practice our values of purpose, excellence, compassion and team.

Leadership -
Takes the initiative to proactively resolve issues, address concerns, identify potential risks, and improve overall processes and outcomes. Seeks new ways to improve individual and team efforts for overall success, while promoting collaboration and teamwork.

Communication -
Shares thoughts and information in a clear, concise, and professional manner, in both oral and written communication formats. Demonstrates active listening and seeks further information to ensure clarity and understanding. Promptly responds to requests for information and works to proactively think through next steps and anticipate potential issues, requests, or business needs. Openly shares knowledge and expertise.

Ethical Practice -
Maintains confidentiality as appropriate, earns trust and respect of others, and exhibits behaviors that express the ethical practice of a healthcare organization. Mitigates unintended consequences through careful analysis and observation of business practices.

Critical Thinking -
Leverages curiosity and insights to explore rationale behind decision-making. Connect pieces of information from various sources to improve problem solving capabilities and recommendations. Actively distinguishes questions, problems, and conflict. Combines existing knowledge and on-the-job experiences to ensure best practices are being implemented in day-to-day work.

Execution -
Addresses problems directly and implements objectives effectively. Produces on time high-quality work deliverables. Able to apply basic project management principles and ensure standard of work is place and reflects leading best practices. Applied earned value principles to managing projects, resource planning and estimates at completion.

Customer Focus -
Identifies short- and long-term customer needs and ensures the effective delivery of high quality and value-added solutions, products, and services that meet or exceed customer expectations.

Project Management -
Develops solutions with sound methodologies, guidelines, and best practices; makes decisions and solve problems within project plan parameters. Identifies patterns and potential underlying issues. Choosing best alternative based on consideration of pros, cons, and weighing various tradeoffs.

Key Relationships

Reports to: Director-Information Services

Direct Reports: n/a
