jobs.title: Project Manager – Specialty Program Manager, Global Artisan Innovation Center
jobs.description:
Job Description

At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility.

Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt.

We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard — from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.

Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.

The Role

The Project Manager – Specialty Program Manager, Global Artisan Innovation Center will serve as the central program leader and primary point of contact between General Motors Defense (GMD), other Specialty Programs and the Global Artisan Innovation Center/PPO organization. This role will establish and lead a structured work-intake, evaluation, and approval process for new Business and ultra-low volume opportunities, ensuring that requests are assessed consistently for capacity, staffing, cost, tooling, process impacts, capital requirements, and schedule feasibility before commitments are made.

The position will coordinate cross-functional teams, lead feasibility and cost-estimating activities, manage strategic studies, and develop repeatable processes that support sustainable GM growth opportunities while protecting existing GAIC/PPO core work commitments.

What You'll Do

Serve as the primary interface between GMD & other specialty customers and GAIC/PPO for new work requests, studies, and business opportunities.
Establish and maintain a single, disciplined intake funnel for all non-traditional requests.
Lead cross-functional review forums involving Manufacturing Engineering, Body, General Assembly, MTS, Engineering, Quality, Finance, Facilities, Strategy and Planning and other stakeholders, including regular interaction and providing direction to Program Teams to influence design and buildability for overall program success.
Develop agendas, decision criteria, governance practices, and approval recommendations for opportunity reviews.
Direct assessments of:
Organizational and production capacity, working with the scheduling team in Program Management.
Salaried and hourly manpower requirements
Staffing availability and workforce risks
Tooling, equipment, and process impacts
Capital investment requirements
Cost estimates, Manufacturing Planning Studies (MPS) and business-case assumptions
Schedule feasibility, timing, and execution risk

Coordinate detailed program studies from initial request through recommendation and leadership decision and discussion.
Lead studies as a pilot for the future opportunities-evaluation model as we develop standardized work processes.
Ensure vehicle content, MTS, Body, General Assembly, scope are clearly understood before commitments are made. Driving to a total-enterprise solution that delivers on SPQRC&E metrics.
Establish consistent communication routines and status reporting between GAIC/PPO and Program stakeholders.
Prevent unauthorized commitments by ensuring requests are evaluated through the approved process.
Develop repeatable standards, templates, tools, and lessons learned for future studies.
Identify risks, constraints, dependencies, and escalation needs; develop mitigation plans with functional leaders.
Partner with shop leadership to evaluate staffing projections, retirements, workforce reductions, apprentice development, and advance-hiring needs.
Support strategic capacity planning and resource prioritization across competing GAIC/PPO and GMD requirements.
Provide Sr. Leader and Executive-level updates, recommendations, and decision packages to leadership.
Influence stakeholders across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
Promote disciplined program-management practices, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement

Core Competencies

Manufacturing program interaction
Strategic planning and prioritization
Cross-functional collaboration
Capacity and workforce planning
Cost and feasibility analysis
Risk and issue management
Stakeholder alignment and communication
Executive influence
Process development and standardization
Decision-making and accountability
Continuous improvement
Operational and manufacturing acumen

Measures of Success

All requests are routed through a defined and consistently applied intake process.
Opportunity decisions are supported by documented capacity, staffing, cost, tooling, capital, and schedule assessments.
GAIC/PPO & program team stakeholders receive clear, timely, and consistent communication.
Study Opportunities establishes a repeatable standardized model for evaluating future opportunities.
Program risks, assumptions, and resource constraints are identified early and escalated appropriately to all stakeholders.
GAIC/PPO growth is aligned with sustainable capacity and workforce plans.
Cross-functional leaders have confidence in the quality, transparency, and timeliness of recommendations.

Working Relationships

This position will work closely with:

GMD program and business-development teams
GAIC/PPO leadership and shop management
Manufacturing, Body, General Assembly, MTS, engineering, quality, and finance
Tooling, facilities, capital planning, and workforce-planning teams
Program Teams and their stakeholders
Space and facilities governance teams
Executive and senior leadership

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will demonstrate enterprise-level ownership, maintain a disciplined and impartial evaluation process, and build trust across Specialty Program Teams and GAIC/PPO. They will balance growth opportunities with current commitments, protect organizational capacity, and ensure that leadership decisions are based on complete, transparent, and fact-based information.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, operations, project management, or a related field or equivalent launch experience.
Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in manufacturing, engineering, product development, defense, or a related environment.
Demonstrated experience with program planning, resource and capacity analysis, cost estimating, risk management, and executive communication.
Experience coordinating multiple functional organizations and managing competing priorities.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, equipment, facilities, General Assembly, and production-readiness considerations.
Proven ability to establish structure and governance in an ambiguous or developing work environment.
Strong written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Ability to make sound recommendations using incomplete information and clearly communicate assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs.
Proficiency with standard project-management, financial-analysis, and collaboration tools.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

Master’s degree or advanced certification in project or program management.
Experience supporting Vehicle Launch as an aMIM or Plant Launch role.
Experience with Manufacturing Planning Studies (MPS’s).
Familiar with General Motors Defense or other defense-related programs.
Familiarity with the Global Vehicle Development Plan (GVDP).
Experience with vehicle manufacturing, machining, body operations, General Assembly, or prototype and low-volume production.
Experience developing work-intake, portfolio-governance, or business-case processes.
Interaction & coordination with Strategy and Planning teams.
Knowledge of GM manufacturing systems, governance practices, and cross-functional decision processes.
Experience with workforce planning, apprentice pipelines, succession planning, or capacity modeling.

GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is categorized as onsite. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location on a full-time basis.

About GM

jobs.description:
Overview

Project Manager-Operational Excellence Senior

Our leaders shape strategic initiatives, develop passionate teams, and work to improve health outcomes. They advance our mission and exemplify excellence, compassion, teamwork and purpose in all that they do .
Indiana University Health is seeking individuals who embody these values to join our Fort Wayne Operational Excellence
team in the role of Project Manager-Operational Excellence Senior
.

Description

Leads high impact initiatives that advance quality, efficiency, and patient-centered care across the health system. Provides strategic oversight, expert facilitation, and disciplined project execution for complex, multi-site improvement efforts. Working closely with clinical and operational leaders, the Senior Project Manager applies change leadership and data-driven decision-making to deliver sustainable performance improvement. Develops comprehensive project plans, charters, and governance structures that align with system strategy. Oversee multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing strategic oversight with hands-on execution. Has awareness of advanced Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies to assess workflows, identify root causes, and design optimized processes. Mentors project teams and junior staff in improvement tools and methodologies. Creates communication plans, training materials, and stakeholder updates tailored to diverse audiences. Facilitate workshops, leadership huddles, and improvement events that promote a culture of continuous improvement. Partners with analytics teams define KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures that support transparency and accountability. Interprets operational and clinical data to identify performance gaps, validate outcomes, and guide prioritization. Serves as a trusted advisor and thought partner to leadership, helping shape systemwide transformation and supporting IU Health's commitment to excellence.

Key Relationships

Reports to: Vice President-Chief Operating Officer, Director of Operational Excellence

Key Relationships: Supporting the Chief Nursing Officer

Direct Reports: None

Candidate Qualifications

Candidates for the position will be evaluated according to the following criteria and competencies.

Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, engineering, or a related field is required.
Requires 5-7 years of relevant experience.
Requires experience in project management, performance improvement, or healthcare operations.
Requires demonstrated success leading complex, multi-site initiatives with measurable outcomes.
Requires proficiency with project management tools, data visualization platforms, and improvement methodologies.
Requires the ability to lead at least 5 projects simultaneously.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred.
Experience in hospital operations, ambulatory care, or health system performance improvement is preferred.
PMP, CAPM, or similar project management certification is preferred.
Familiarity with regulatory standards, quality frameworks, and patient safety principles is preferred.

Responsibilities

Connect to Promise - Demonstrates a commitment to IU Health's mission, vision, and values by exhibiting behaviors and delivering results that align with the strategic direction of the organization. Ensure IU Health is working toward its vision of improving the health of all Hoosiers by providing the best care for each person as we practice our values of purpose, excellence, compassion and team.
Project Management - Develops solutions with sound methodologies, guidelines, and best practices; makes decisions and solves problems within project plan parameters. Identifies patterns and potential underlying issues. Choosing best alternative based on consideration of pros, cons, and weighing various tradeoffs.
Business Acumen - Exhibits working knowledge of the department and function and how it is structured. Structures work to align with the goals and operations of department and function.
Execution - Addresses problems directly and implements objectives effectively. Produces on time high-quality work deliverables. Able to apply basic project management principles and ensure standard of work is in place and reflects leading best practices.
Collaboration - Coordinates job activities with team members and leaders as required. Finds workable solutions that can be leveraged by other team members. Seeks out and shares best practices for performing job duties. Engages, guides and mentors of other team members as needed.
Leadership - Takes the initiative to proactively resolve issues, address concerns, identify potential risks, and improve overall processes and outcomes. Seeks new ways to improve individual and team efforts for overall success, while promoting collaboration and teamwork.
Communication - Shares thoughts and information in a clear, concise and professional manner, in both oral and written communication formats. Demonstrates active listening and seeks further information to ensure clarity and understanding. Promptly responds to requests for information and works to proactively think through next steps and anticipate potential issues, requests, or business needs. Openly shares knowledge and expertise.

jobs.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.
Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.
Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
We are seeking a highly collaborative and strategic Business Operations Manager  (Product Data Insights & Reporting)
to serve as the vital operational bridge between our technical data execution and cross-functional business decision-making. In this role, you will lead the effort to transform product and organizational data into actionable insights for our Product and Engineering organization, driving alignment and helping senior leadership make high-impact decisions.
You are an exceptional relationship builder, translator, and team advocate. Rather than focusing on hands-on technical execution, your strength lies in your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, influence stakeholders across diverse teams, and translate complex data points into compelling narratives that drive business outcomes.
You impact

Establish deep, trusting partnerships with engineering and product stakeholders as well as cross-functional leadership, acting as the primary strategic bridge between analytical execution and business decision-making.
Translate analytical projects into highly compelling narratives, framing our roadmap in a way that resonates with senior stakeholders and drives meaningful alignment.
Navigate organizational dynamics and competing priorities with high political acumen, ensuring data-backed recommendations are successfully adopted and operationalized.
Maintain stakeholder momentum and manage expectations gracefully during long delivery cycles, keeping partners excited and bought into the long-term analytics vision.
Advocate passionately for the analytics function, leveraging high demand for insights to build compelling cases for expanded support.
Lead, mentor, and protect a lean team of technical analysts, providing the necessary "air cover" for them to focus on deep execution while actively coaching them on communication and influencing skills.

Your Qualifications 

Strong experience within the technology industry
Extensive knowledge of product operations, business insights, program management, or a related role—ideally within a fast-paced SaaS, product, or engineering organization.
A strong background of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of hiring, developing, and leading high-performing teams.
Exceptional communication, executive presence, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and build consensus among senior leadership.
Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance) and successfully influencing decision-making without direct authority.
Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn complex technical data into simple, actionable insights for senior leadership.
Ability to manage a high volume of incoming requests, establish clear operational triage frameworks, and comfortably manage stakeholder expectations.
A solid understanding of how product analytics and reporting structures operate (e.g., data flows, modeling, or visualization tools) to effectively translate technical needs, though hands-on coding/modeling is not required.
Deep understanding of modern development methodologies (e.g., Agile, SAFe) and the product lifecycle in a SaaS context.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  
Anaplan does not:  
Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   
C andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

Your Role

The Program Manager Consultant, Custom Product Implementation Triage, reports to the Principal Program Manager and supports complex group requests, strategic initiatives, and product implementation issue resolution. This role serves as the primary intake point of contact for Product processes, ensuring requests are complete, assessed, prioritized, and routed to the appropriate teams. The role leverages existing systems and workflows to improve efficiency, strengthen prioritization, and support smooth product implementation.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Provide overall program leadership, guidance, and manage all aspects of a given operational program or custom group onboarding, including requirements gathering, business case creation, and driving implementation and issue resolution
Develop resourcing strategies to ensure optimum support for projects and for the day-to-day operational activities
Lead large, complex implementations spanning multiple business areas to deliver strategic initiatives and measurable business value
Support and coach project managers within the program, while providing technical expertise in planning, execution, and leadership of program, projects, and initiatives
Be a trusted adviser to Product leadership, Senior Managers, Program Managers, and key stakeholders; serving as a Product Subject Matter Expert (SME) and overall program leadership ensuring appropriate processes are utilized, stakeholders are informed, and appropriate Product points of contact are engaged
Ensure documentation and proper intake of various strategic requests of Product and guides request through governance, feasibility, level of effort through implementation and automation within Product systems
Manage risks to implementation and agree on appropriate actions to mitigate/control ensuring strong governance is fully embedded with goals of urgent resolution and escalating promptly. Regularly review risk assessment with Product Leads, Senior Managers, Sales, and Implementation Teams and/or others as needed
Review operational processes to determine gaps and inefficiencies; provides suggestions to leadership on improving/designing standard operational processes to increase operational reliability
In an ever-changing environment, ensures process workflows and DLPs are always accurate and updated engaging MOC where needed
Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
Requires at least 7 years of prior relevant experience
Advanced experience with Microsoft Office Suite with preferred background with ShieldLink, Facets, JIRA, and Visio
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills required
Possesses great organization skills and ability to prioritize effectively while managing multiple assignments, deliverables, and responsibilities
Extensive experience in management of large initiatives and/or programs, ability to provide steady leadership in the face of uncertainty, change, and aggressive deadlines
Extensive experience with developing and documenting business requirements and creating presentation materials

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

## About the Role

Sardine is seeking a Data Analyst to join its Fraud Intelligence team at the intersection of data evaluation, vendor strategy, and fraud detection. You’ll serve as the analytical engine behind evaluating, testing, and onboarding third-party data signals and vendor partnerships, determining which data assets improve fraud outcomes for clients.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role working closely with the Head of Fraud, Product, Data Engineering, and client-facing teams. You’ll build rigorous evaluation frameworks, analyze vendor data, quantify fraud-signal value, and translate complex findings into actionable recommendations for a fast-moving, data-driven environment.

## Key Responsibilities

- Design and execute structured evaluation frameworks to assess the quality, coverage, and fraud-signal value of incoming vendor data assets.
- Build lift analyses, backtests, and champion/challenger comparisons to quantify the incremental value of new data signals against the existing fraud detection stack.
- Profile vendor datasets for completeness, freshness, match rates, and population coverage across industries such as crypto, fintech, neobanks, and e-commerce.
- Collaborate with fraud leadership to define evaluation criteria tied to real-world fraud outcomes.
- Analyze false positive rates, catch rates, and precision/recall tradeoffs when evaluating fraud signals.
- Translate vendor data findings into clear recommendations, including whether to adopt, pilot, deprioritize, or decline a data asset.
- Partner with Data Engineering to define data ingestion requirements and ensure testing environments reflect production-like conditions.
- Document evaluation results and maintain an internal knowledge base of vendor data performance over time.
- Conduct ad hoc deep dives into fraud trends, model performance, and client-specific data questions.
- Work with cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex analytical findings into actionable fraud intelligence.

- 3–5 years of experience in data analysis, data science, or a related analytical role.

- Solid understanding of evaluation metrics and statistical concepts, including:
- Precision and recall
- AUC/ROC
- Lift
- Population distributions
- A/B testing fundamentals
- Experience working with external or third-party datasets, including evaluating data quality, match rates, and signal value.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Comfort working with ambiguity and independently creating structure in a fast-moving environment.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in fraud, risk, fintech, or a data-heavy B2B SaaS environment.
- Familiarity with fraud signals and data types such as device fingerprinting, identity graph data, consortium data, behavioral signals, and email/phone intelligence.

- Exposure to machine learning concepts and feature engineering, even without full machine learning engineering experience.
- Experience working across fintech verticals such as crypto, BNPL, neobanks, or payments.

- Risk analytics

jobs.title: IT Security Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Company

Corporate Imaging Concepts (CIC) is a branded merchandise and e-commerce company headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois, with a full warehouse and operations facility in Alpharetta, Georgia. CIC builds and runs online storefronts and fulfillment programs for enterprise clients, which means the company manages payment flows, customer data, and the security expectations that come with serving large organizations.

About the Role

The IT Security Analyst owns security as a discipline for CIC, including security posture, compliance, vendor risk, and incident response. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad ownership and visible impact. The role partners closely with the Infrastructure Manager, who owns networks, servers, and endpoints as systems, while this position owns the security controls, policies, and compliance obligations that sit on top of them and the role would be reporting directly to IT leadership. CIC has a small IT team, so this role requires comfort with shared team responsibilities. Security is the primary mandate, but the IT Security Analyst should also expect to support ticket management and hands-on infrastructure support alongside the Infrastructure Manager. The right candidate values variety, pragmatism, and the opportunity to secure the full environment of a growing company without overbuilding an enterprise-scale security program.

Responsibilities

Security Posture & Controls

Own day-to-day security posture, including identity and access controls such as MFA, conditional access, and privileged accounts.
Support endpoint protection, email security, and patching priorities in partnership with Infrastructure.
Monitor and triage alerts using appropriately scaled tooling and recommend where tooling should or should not grow.
Advise leadership on security risk in clear, prioritized terms, including what matters now, what can wait, and what it costs.

Compliance, Documentation & Vendor Risk

Own client-facing security compliance, including security questionnaires and vendor risk assessments.
Maintain security documentation and policies that are practical, current, and appropriate for CIC’s size and environment.
Support payment cards, PCI-related obligations with CIC’s processing partners.
Run vendor security reviews for the platforms and integrations CIC relies on.

Incident Response & Awareness

Own the incident response process, including first-line triage, coordination during events, and post-incident follow-through.
Run right-sized security awareness activities, including phishing simulation, onboarding training, and practical guidance people can follow.

Shared IT Team Responsibilities

Work on the support queue by triaging, resolving, and managing user support tickets as part of the IT team’s shared rotation.
Provide hands-on infrastructure support alongside the Infrastructure Manager, including endpoints, accounts, Microsoft 365 administration, and day-to-day systems work as needed.

Qualifications

3-6 years of hands-on security experience in an analyst or engineer role, with recent personal experience deploying, tuning, and maintaining security controls.
Practical depth in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID security, endpoint protection, and email security.
Experience answering client security questionnaires or completing vendor risk assessments, including the ability to triage large, detailed assessments against deadlines.
Working familiarity with PCI-DSS concepts; experience in an e-commerce, retail, or SaaS environment is a strong plus.
Strong judgment to operate as a one-person security function, including prioritizing strategically, deferring accurately, and communicating clearly.
Genuine comfort with generalist IT work, including support tickets and infrastructure tasks.
Relevant certifications such as Security+, CySA+, or SSCP is welcome; senior certifications are not required.

Preferred Skills

MSP or small-team IT background with experience managing breadth, ticket discipline, and shifting priorities.
SOC 2 or similar attestation exposure, either client-side or audit-side.
Experience with Azure security tooling and scripting such as PowerShell or Python for automation.
Experience working alongside SAP or other ERP environments.

What This Role Is Not

This is not a management role with direct reports, a pure-security seat, or a SOC shift position. Part of the week will include support tickets and infrastructure work because CIC operates with a small IT team. The opportunity is to serve as the security function for a growing company with real ownership from day one and room for the role to grow as the business grows.

Why This Role Matters

The IT Security Analyst helps protect CIC’s people, clients, data, systems, and brand reputation. This role brings practical structure to security and compliance while staying grounded in the realities of a hands-on, fast-moving business.

Location and pay

Hybrid from our Northbrook, IL headquarters or our Alpharetta, GA warehouse and operations facility — regular onsite presence is part of the role, given the hands-on infrastructure and support responsibilities at both sites. Candidates should be within commuting distance of Northbrook or Alpharetta. Base salary range $95,000–$110,000 depending on experience, plus benefits.

Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
Life Insurance
Paid Time Off
401K Plan and Employer Discretionary Match
Gym Membership Contribution
Hybrid Work Environment

Equal Opportunity Statement

CIC is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.

Contribute to broader Compliance Product Line initiatives as the portfolio evolves, applying and developing business analysis skills across additional compliance programs and technology solutions in partnership with the Ethics & Compliance Office.
Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and collaborating with the Product Manager. Participate in product planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and product goals.

We currently have an opportunity for a Data Analyst, Mobility Insights & Road Safety to join the Road Safety Data Services team.
This role supports the development and delivery of ICBC's Mobility Insights Strategy and broader road safety initiatives by transforming data, research, and stakeholder input into meaningful insights that support evidence-based decision-making.
Working closely with business leaders, analysts, technical specialists, and external partners, the successful candidate will help deliver mobility insights, support stakeholder engagement activities, contribute to information-sharing and governance initiatives, and assist in the development of analytical products, reports, and decision-support materials.
This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to road safety, mobility, and transportation initiatives that support safer and more sustainable mobility outcomes across British Columbia.

Job Responsibilities:

Research, Analysis & Insight Delivery
Analyze data, research, and stakeholder input to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and emerging issues in road safety, mobility, and transportation.
Develop reports, dashboards, presentations, decision-support materials, and recurring mobility insight products.
Track program outcomes, performance measures, evaluation frameworks, and benefits realization.

Stakeholder Engagement & Project Delivery
Support stakeholder workshops, interviews, consultations, needs assessments, and collaborative planning.
Document outcomes, decisions, action items, and follow-up activities.
Coordinate project plans, work tracking, and delivery across multiple initiatives.
Build effective relationships with internal and external partners.

Data Governance & Information Sharing
Support data sharing, governance, privacy, stewardship, access, metadata, and information management.
Maintain agreements, inventories, governance processes, documentation, and knowledge assets.
Coordinate partner data-sharing discussions and workshops.

Continuous Improvement
Improve reporting, processes, information products, templates, and knowledge resources.
Monitor mobility and road safety trends, leading practices, and stakeholder needs.
Promote collaboration, innovation, and evidence-based decision-making.

Position Requirements:

The successful candidate brings the following qualifications, knowledge, and experience:
Core Qualifications
Experience in research, analytics, reporting, or business analysis, including translating data into actionable insights.
Strong analytical, critical-thinking, communication, organization, coordination, and attention-to-detail skills.
Experience supporting multi-stakeholder projects and preparing reports, presentations, and briefing materials.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Knowledge & Expertise

Required knowledge:
Knowledge of research, data interpretation, reporting, business analysis, and problem-solving methods.
Knowledge of stakeholder engagement, facilitation, performance measurement, information management, and data governance.
Knowledge of transportation, mobility, road safety, or public-sector environments is an asset.

Technical and professional experience:
Experience with SQL, Excel, and data analysis tools.
Experience with Tableau, Power BI, QuickSight, or similar reporting platforms.
Experience preparing reports and presentations, coordinating workshops and stakeholders, and maintaining project documentation.

Education & Experience:
Undergraduate degree in Business, Economics, Geography, Transportation Planning, Public Policy, Statistics, Data Analytics, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
Experience in analytics, research, business analysis, reporting, project coordination, consulting, or a related field.
Experience with large datasets, analytical tools, transportation, mobility, road safety, government, insurance, infrastructure, or public-sector environments is an asset.
An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Position Information:

Road Safety Data Services supports evidence-based decision-making through road safety analytics, mobility insights, performance measurement, data governance, research, and stakeholder engagement. The team works with internal and external partners to understand transportation and road safety challenges, evaluate interventions, identify emerging risks, and improve mobility outcomes across British Columbia.
Success in this role means helping translate data, research, and stakeholder input into actionable insights while supporting the delivery of ICBC's Mobility Insights Strategy and broader road safety objectives.

jobs.title: Sr. Fraud Investigations Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re Sagen

Sagen is Canada’s leading private mortgage insurance company making home ownership more accessible to first time homebuyers. For the past 30 years we have been focused on being the most trusted partner for lenders and brokers.

Our expertise in superior customer service, thought leadership, and industry knowledge has allowed us to be a driving force for our most important stakeholder, our valued customers. Our best-in-class team across the country work tirelessly to make every deal the most important deal. We are 100% Canadian-owned and believe in helping all Canadians achieve their dream of homeownership.

Sagen’s collaborative culture inspires our people to be authentic and curious while pursuing excellence in what they do.

Ready to Make an Impact?

The Senior Fraud Investigations Analyst, reporting to the Manager, Fraud, is responsible for conducting comprehensive reviews of mortgage insurance applications to support the detection and prevention of fraudulent information. The role supports the ability of Operations to reduce overall fraud related risks, drive fraud awareness education and ongoing improvement to the overall customer experience and the mortgage industry.

Here is where you will be focusing to ensure your success

Complete in-depth investigations and analysis into all aspects of mortgage fraud transactions by extracting and analyzing data from multiple systems and tools.
Establish and leverage internal and external relationships with customers, industry partners and investigative bodies to support the development and implementation of fraud detection and prevention solutions.
Analyze transactional data to identify fraud patterns, system, and procedural weakness and required data/information to provide recommendations for innovative process improvement solutions.
Prepare and distribute analytics reporting and presentations to communicate departmental and portfolio performance as it pertains to frauds/misrepresentations.
Presentation of investigative conclusions/findings and recommendations to Operations Management.
Collaborate with Loss Mitigation, Risk, Sales, and Underwriting Operations to help influence and assist in the development and maintenance of fraud/risk related policies, guidelines, and operational processes.
Participate in industry related committees/associations where available to maintain knowledge of current fraud trends, tools, and information.
Develop, maintain and deliver fraud and misrepresentation training to internal and external customers to communicate and reinforce the importance of Fraud Management and ensure a clear understanding in French and English.
Participate in various special projects as required.
Provide the highest level of internal and external customer service.
Support Operations stakeholders ability to deliver established SLAs through timely resolution of investigations.

What We Are Looking For

University degree in Business, Economics, Commerce or equivalent education and work experience.
Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in Mortgage Underwriting, Mortgage Fraud Investigations & Analytics required.
Strong technical knowledge of mortgage underwriting processes and regulatory requirements.
Strong investigative, analytical, and critical thinking abilities.
Strong judgment, professionalism, and attention to detail
Passion for continuous learning and staying informed of emerging industry trends.
Bilingual in French (written and verbal) are an asset
Strong communication skills verbal and written
Strong presentation skills for internal/external audiences
The ability to exchange sensitive or technical information with a non-technical audience as well as influence key stakeholders.
Strong interpersonal, relationship building and customer centric skills.
Ability to work effectively within a team environment, with strong collaboration abilities
Demonstrated strength in working independently – ability to make decisions, manage deliverables and resolve issues while seeking guidance on more complex situations.
Ability to thrive in a constantly changing, high volume, and fast paced environment while managing multiple priorities to meet deadlines.
Analytical thinker with ability to challenge the status quo and drive change.
Expert knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and Power BI is an asset.

What's In It for you!

At Sagen we understand that your health and financial well-being are equally important and offer a total rewards package that includes competitive compensation, annual performance bonus, medical and dental benefits, company funded pension plan, matching RRSP, TFSA and/or Non-registered Savings Plans, work from anywhere days, and an environment that creates a sense of belonging to inspire you to be your very best.

Ready to join Sagen

At Sagen, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, as evidenced by our partnerships with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion (CCDI) and Black Mentorship Inc. We strive to create a sense of belonging where all employees, from every background and ability, are welcomed, respected, and empowered to be their authentic selves.

jobs.title: Data Analyst I
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Collaborates with business owners, data scientists, and data engineers to identify, prioritize and formulate relevant data analysis efforts. Collects, integrates, cleans and refines data and conducts Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). Communicates results and implications to team members and internal customers. Creates user-friendly reports and dashboards and trains customers on their interpretation and use.

Data Analyst I is distinguished from Data Analyst II by their applicable knowledge level and experience. Those in the later position would have the responsibility for performing more complex data analytics and designing experiments, with a sound understanding of Credit Union business operations, products and compliance requirements.

Job Description

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Conducts descriptive and exploratory analytics, understanding and communicating what a dataset can tell us about (for example) members, products, processes, competition, the economic environment, and marketing promotions.
Creates reports, visualizations and dashboards to answer business questions. Trains business customers on their interpretation and use.
Assesses data cleanliness and cleans data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, reliability, relevance and timeliness.
Continuously builds domain expertise in various credit union subject areas, such as (for example) marketing, underwriting, fraud, and servicing channels.
Completes all required training programs to maintain a current knowledge applicable to assigned duties and responsibilities, including regulatory compliance requirements.

Company Wide Expectations

Maintains a professional image and demeanor at all times, consistently demonstrating Credit Union RISE Values and adhering to the Code of Ethics.
Delivers friendly, caring service to internal and external members.
Complies with all applicable State, Federal and NCUA rules and regulations and all Credit Union policies and procedures.
Follow all physical and online security procedures and maintain strict confidentiality of all member information.
Completes all required regulatory and compliance training and maintains required knowledge of Credit Union products and services.
Works scheduled hours and maintains punctuality.
Performs other related duties as assigned or requested.

Education/Experience

To perform this job satisfactorily, an employee must be able to carry out each essential duty competently. The requirements listed below are representative of the education, experience, skills and abilities required. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Education Requirements

4 Year / Bachelors Degree - Business Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Finance, or closely related field - Required

Experience Requirement

1 Year- Responsible business domain experience in data analytics - analytical experience in consumer finance preferred - Required
Experience with various data/analytical tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, SAS/SPSS, PowerBI, Tableau, Incorta) - Required
Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python or R) for data cleaning, exploratory/descriptive data analysis - Preferred

Skills/Abilities

Effectively apply internal/external customer service practices and processes to meet quality service standards and achieve member satisfaction.
Learn and apply information, on a wide range of Credit Union products, services and regulatory compliance requirements, in order to assess member situations and develop solutions.
Communicate in a professional manner and deliver information clearly and effectively. Actively listen to questions, opinions and ideas of others. Use tact and diplomacy in sensitive and confidential situations.
Use correct English including spelling, grammar and punctuation.
Understand and follow written and oral instructions.
Strong analytical aptitude with a driving curiosity to identify, formulate, and solve problems.
Ability to assess cost trade-offs related to decision-making and further data acquisition/analysis in a business context.
Comfortable deriving business implications from data/analyses and making recommendations for business action--even in the absence of complete information.
Desire and ability to continuously learn new analytical methods and tools in order to have increasing impact on business results.
Ability to train and develop others.
Set priorities and manage one’s own time effectively.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by employees to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Physical Requirements

Intermittent standing, sitting, walking, bending and climbing.
Using hands repetitively to handle, feel or operate computers and other standard office equipment.
Reaching with hands and arms.
Intermittent lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds.

Works in a general office environment.

High adaptability and flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, evolving business environment with shifting priorities
Experience proactively identifying and resolving blockers, escalating issues, and remediating pain points

Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes or resolve complex issues
Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
Experience in managing cross-functional projects and teams

jobs.title: IT & Security Manager
jobs.description:
The role

As Wayve grows across continents, we are looking for a Corporate Security Engineering Manager to own the systems and controls layer the whole company runs on: identity, endpoint, device and asset lifecycle, SaaS, and the and the security controls implemented in all of them. Most of this role is platform ownership. You will lead a distributed team of engineers across the UK, Germany and the US.

This is a build role. We are standing this layer up properly for the first time, so you will shape how it works rather than inherit someone else's design, and the team and headcount to do it are already approved.

It is one of three peer leadership roles in our infrastructure, IT and security function, all reporting to the same Head of IT. One peer owns the network estate, one owns our global support service, and you own the platforms and the controls. You will also work closely with our central Security team and with the engineering teams whose work depends the platforms you own.

You will do well here if you like owning platforms end to end, turning manual work into automation, and growing the engineers around you.

Key responsibilities

Own the operation of our corporate security controls: endpoint hardening, identity and access, privileged access, vulnerability and patch management, and access reviews.
Partner with our central Security team on policy, vulnerability management and incident response. They own those processes; you make them real in the IT environment.
Own Okta and everything on it: application onboarding, SSO and SAML migration, group and attribute automation, the application catalogue, and the automation that grants and revokes access. Our Helpdesk Lead runs the joiner, mover and leaver process itself; you own the platform it runs on and the evidence that access was revoked.
Own endpoint management across a genuinely mixed Mac, Windows and Linux fleet, covering enrolment, baselines, patching and compliance reporting.
Own device and asset lifecycle and SaaS and licensing, including records, reconciliation, audit process, inventory accuracy, tenant administration and vendor relationships.
Lead, grow and hire a distributed team across three countries and several time zones, and develop engineers into domain owners with clear standards behind each domain.

Turn certification requirements into implemented controls, and into evidence the platform produces on demand.

jobs.title: Market Data Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Since our founding in 1996, Numerix has been at the vanguard of financial technology, providing quantitative analytics and software that redefine pricing and risk management across the financial markets. Through recent strategic acquisitions, Numerix has further strengthened its leadership position, empowering financial institutions worldwide to transform risk into opportunity with confidence. As AI reshapes capital markets technology, Numerix is focused on combining the speed and flexibility of AI with the deterministic, auditable, and governed calculations that financial institutions require.

We are seeking a Market Data Operations Analyst
to support Numerix SaaS clients by monitoring market data generation processes used by Numerix Financial Systems to ensure the integrity and the quality of market data as part of Numerix Data Management (NXDM) framework. This role involves technical and functional support, incident management, and coordination with clients and internal teams (P&E, PS, etc.), contributing directly to operational excellence and client satisfaction.

What You'll Do:

Define, implement, and execute standard operating procedures for Numerix clients’ market data operation processes.
Perform daily monitoring and verification of market data deliveries—including scheduled intraday and end-of-day snapshots for multiple clients—by checking the success or failure of runs, batch processes, and data feeds to ensure operational integrity and SLA compliance.
Enhance existing processes through optimization and automation of manual checks.
Respond to daily requests for operational support activities related to market data queries, raised by both our clients and internal groups.
Monitor, triage, and resolve technical and data quality issues related to Numerix data feeds, escalating to developers, vendors, or other stakeholders as needed.
Engage with vendors to address inquiries related to market data availability, delivery or quality.
Coordinate NXDM releases and production patch deployments with clients, and support development teams in executing and validating parallel runs.
Act as Incident Manager in accordance with incident management policies for market data incidents, leading Post-Mortem review and root cause analysis to drive continuous improvement.
Assist Numerix clients (financial institutions) with our API platform for market data related issues and queries.

What We're Looking For:

Bachelor’s degree from a leading engineering university, or equivalent professional experience.
Good experience in Python for ad-hoc data analysis and automating manual processes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; practical exposure to SQL is beneficial for the role.
Understanding of exchange-traded and OTC derivatives (e.g., forwards, futures, options) across multiple asset classes, including IR, commodities, credit, equities, and FX. Familiarity with financial concepts such as volatility and beta is advantageous.
Working Knowledge of Cloud Services, ideally AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, EC2, DynamoDB, etc.) is a plus.
Strong troubleshooting abilities and good English communication skills.
Willingness to work in US shift when required (3:00 PM to 11:30 PM MST).

Extra Credit:

Understanding of multiple asset classes (IR, Commodities, Credit, Equities, FX).
Ability to use Excel, Python and SQL for ad-hoc data analysis and investigation of market data issues.

Where You’ll Work:

This is a fully remote role open to anyone who is authorized to work in India.

An important note on salary:

The annual pay range for this position is based on the preferred primary location of the role which is listed above. If you are applying to this role at a location that is not the preferred primary location, please keep in mind the salary range will vary and may fall outside of what is listed. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Also note that unsolicited contact from third-party recruiters or agencies will not be considered at this time. We respectfully request no outreach from agencies.

About Stratus

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. The Role

We are seeking a Project Operations Analyst to provide hands-on support to project managers and business leaders across day-to-day operational and project delivery activities. Responsibilities

Support project managers with project setup, cost tracking, forecasting, estimate at completion (EAC) analysis, and project reviews

Collaborate with finance and operations teams to ensure accurate and timely project data in ERP and reporting systems

Required

Hands-on experience supporting PMs with project setup, cost management, and forecasting

Proficiency with Deltek Vantagepoint, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms
Working knowledge of PMI project management frameworks and lifecycle
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across project teams and business units

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Description

The Revenue Operations Analyst will join Epsilon’s Revenue Operations team in a foundational support role designed to strengthen day-to-day operational support for sales leaders and business partners. This role will help own operational and execution-oriented responsibilities related to revenue operations, creating clearer focus across the team and enabling business unit partners and functional RevOps leads to stay aligned to their core areas of ownership across business partnership, process design, governance, analytics, and systems implementation.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, comfortable working with data, and interested in building depth in how revenue operations supports sales execution across a complex business. The role will provide hands-on exposure to CRM data quality, sales process and systems administration, reporting support, intake tracking, documentation, and cross-functional coordination.

Responsibilities

Sales Leader and Business Partner Support

Provide operational and coordination support to sales leaders and RevOps business unit partners across recurring sales operations activities.
Help track, organize, and follow up on sales support requests, intake items, and open operational tasks.
Prepare and maintain recurring materials, trackers, summaries, and status updates used by sales leadership and RevOps stakeholders.

CRM, Data Quality, and Process Administration

Assist with CRM data hygiene activities, including identifying missing, outdated, inconsistent, or duplicate information.
Support maintenance of account, opportunity, pipeline, forecast, and sales activity data according to established RevOps standards.
Help ensure sales teams are following defined processes, required fields, naming conventions, and data entry expectations.

Reporting and Analytics Support

Support recurring sales and pipeline reporting by gathering inputs, validating data, refreshing standard reports, and preparing summaries for review.
Assist with basic analysis of sales operations data, including pipeline movement, activity tracking, data completeness, and process adherence.
Partner with Revenue Intelligence and business partners to clarify reporting requests and ensure needed inputs are captured accurately.
Help document reporting definitions, field usage, and business rules to support consistency across revenue reporting.

Documentation, Enablement, and Continuous Improvement

Create and maintain documentation for repeatable sales operations processes, support workflows, and RevOps operating procedures.
Support training and enablement efforts by helping prepare job aids, process guides, checklists, and simple how-to materials.

What Success Looks Like

Sales leaders and business partners receive timely, accurate support on recurring operational needs.
Operational work is organized, tracked, and completed consistently.
CRM and sales operations data is complete, accurate, and aligned to established standards.
Recurring reports, trackers, and process documentation are maintained with strong attention to detail.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, marketing, or a related field.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage recurring tasks accurately and consistently.
Comfort working with data, spreadsheets, trackers, and structured processes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to learn CRM and reporting tools quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize information clearly.
Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.
Interest in revenue operations, sales operations, business process improvement, or go-to-market operations.

Preferred

Relevant experience through internships, coursework, project work, or prior roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business operations, analytics, finance, or marketing operations.
Exposure to Salesforce or another CRM platform.
Experience building or maintaining trackers, reports, dashboards, process documentation, or project status updates.
Familiarity with sales pipeline, forecasting, account management, lead/opportunity workflows, or commercial operations concepts.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is eager to learn, takes pride in accuracy, and is motivated by improving process, organization, and operational consistency. They are comfortable with operational detail, able to follow and improve repeatable processes, and interested in growing within revenue operations over time. This person should be service-oriented, dependable, and willing to lean into the details that help sales leaders and business partners work more effectively.

This role can serve as a foundation for growth into the Revenue Operations function. As the analyst builds experience, they may take on more advanced ownership of reporting, process improvement, CRM administration, project coordination, or business unit partnership support.

About The Role

Supports day-to-day business operations by managing report requests, maintaining data accuracy, and ensuring reliable information delivery across assigned business units. This role emphasizes hands-on data analysis, troubleshooting, and basic to moderate report generation, with a focus on execution and strategic design.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Provides data-driven insights to bank-level managers, including retail, loan servicing, and credit teams. Responds to data requests by reviewing existing reports, offering alternative solutions when the exact data is unavailable, ensuring that all stakeholders receive relevant and actionable information.

Actively develops proficiency in the automation software's functionalities by independently handling low-risk requests and contributing to projects that utilize the software and data analytics.

Skills And Qualifications

Clearly convey information, both verbally and in writing, so others can understand complex data and instructions.

Works efficiently with others toward a shared goal, including sharing knowledge and seeking input.
Process and verify information with precision, minimizing errors and ensuring the integrity of data.
Identity issues, analyze root causes, and determine logical, practical solutions.

Demonstrated experience in designing, analyzing, and improving business processes is preferred.

jobs.description:
About Stratus

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public- and private-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

The Role

We are seeking a Project Operations Analyst to provide hands-on support to project managers and business leaders across day-to-day operational and project delivery activities. This role is a critical resource for PMs navigating project setup, forecasting, and cost management, while also supporting leadership with financial analysis and performance reporting.

Responsibilities

Support project managers with project setup, cost tracking, forecasting, estimate at completion (EAC) analysis, and project reviews
Monitor project portfolio performance including margin variance, unbilled, and A/R, and partner with PMs to address issues proactively
Provide financial and operational analysis to division and market leadership to support decision-making and performance improvement
Prepare monthly financial reports, quarterly forecasts, and preliminary project budgets for assigned markets or business units
Assist with opportunity and pursuit tracking, project execution pricing models, and risk management activities
Serve as a day-to-day resource and advocate for project managers, providing guidance on company policies, procedures, and project delivery tools
Develop job aids, tracking tools, and templates that simplify project delivery workflows and improve PM compliance
Collaborate with finance and operations teams to ensure accurate and timely project data in ERP and reporting systems

Qualifications

Required

4-7 years of experience in project controls, operations coordination, or PMO support within AEC or professional services
Hands-on experience supporting PMs with project setup, cost management, and forecasting
Strong analytical and Excel skills; experience with financial modeling, variance analysis, and performance reporting
Proficiency with Deltek Vantagepoint, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms
Working knowledge of PMI project management frameworks and lifecycle
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across project teams and business units
Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment

Preferred

Experience developing cost management tracking tools or operational dashboards
Background in individual training or coaching project managers on financial performance
Familiarity with AEC industry project delivery models and market structures

Why you’ll love Stratus

A team-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success
Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize
Learning & Development – Education and Professional Licensing
We believe flexible, hybrid work supports the balance and well-being our team deserves
Excellent Health Care Programs – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
Voluntary Life Insurance options for employees, spouses, and dependents
401k Retirement Plan with employer match
Paid Holidays & Competitive PTO plans

Interested in learning more about Stratus, please visit https://www.stratusteam.com/ .

jobs.description:
Company: CGIC

Department: Claims

Employment Type: Regular Full-Time

Work Model: Hybrid (2 days in office)

Language: Bilingualism in English and French is an asset.

The Opportunity

We are a leading Canadian financial services co-operative committed to being a catalyst for a sustainable and resilient society and our team is essential to deliver on this strategy. That’s why we prioritize our people, to ensure we provide a strong culture and development opportunities which enables our team to thrive and to live our purpose. The best part is that you will work with people that care passionately about you, our clients and our communities.

Our Claims team aspires to create peace of mind for our clients and our communities. Our national team of knowledgeable and trusted professionals serve our clients with compassion. We are passionate about continuous improvement and operate with high-integrity, motivated by our desire to do the right thing for our clients.

As Data Analyst, you actively contribute to various initiatives by analyzing data to solve business problems and providing valuable insights. You understand the insurance business domain and ensure your own tasks contribute to meeting the business objectives by applying appropriate methods and critical thinking and performing analysis.

How You Will Create Impact

Autonomously perform descriptive and diagnostic analysis using recommended methods (ex: regression, cohort analysis, cluster analysis, A/B testing, factor analysis).
Design and develop metrics to enable descriptive analysis and diagnostic analysis.
Autonomously design proof of concept and deliver with guidance a prototype analytical solution to enable effective storytelling and descriptive/diagnostic analysis.
Work on Data querying (T-SQL, SQL, MySQL, etc.)
Extract, clean, reconcile and prepare the data required for the analysis.
Autonomously communicate findings to colleagues and your manager in an effective manner.

To Join Our Team

You have 3-5 years of relevant experience in Business Intelligence or other relevant domain.
You have a University Degree in Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent technical experience.
ACAS or FCAS designations are considered an asset.
You have experience solving standard problems by analyzing possible solutions by using our experience, judgment and precedent & challenging status quo.
You have good knowledge and understanding of data analysis, programing, modeling techniques, data warehouse and data management, research, architecture and design.
Experience with the following technologies is required: Sql, Python, R, Microsoft Fabric
Experience with the following technologies is an asset: Service now , Jira, Databricks

How You Will Succeed

You influence change and are committed to continuous improvement, in order to exceed client expectations.
You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions.
Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages.
You’re an effective team player who shares knowledge to support our peers.

What You Need To Know

You will be subject to a Background check as a condition of employment, in the event you are the successful candidate.

What’s in it for you?

Training and development opportunities to grow your career.
Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs.
A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture.
Paid volunteer days to give back to your community.
In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program.

Salary information

Expected Salary range
: CAD
$60,574.00 to $100,956.00 CAD

The salary amount for the successful candidate is determined by Co-operators in its discretion and will vary depending on several criteria including but not limited to: local market conditions, geography and relevant job-related factors such as knowledge, skills, qualification, experience and education.

Employees may also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn additional compensation tied to individual and/or business performance, or other business metrics.

jobs.title: Environmental Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Description

GSI is seeking an Environmental Data Analyst who combines technical ability, analytical creativity, and business acumen to strengthen our data management, analysis, and visualization team. The ideal candidate is comfortable across the full data lifecycle—building and maintaining relational databases, developing analysis and automation pipelines in SQL, Python, and/or R, and providing query, reporting, and visualization support in a collaborative organization working closely with technical staff. Familiarity with environmental chemistry data generated from field investigations of water, soil, sediment, air, and biological matrices is valued. The candidate should know how to analyze system requirements and be familiar with relational databases, statistical analysis, and modern data visualization techniques using relevant and current tools.

GSI provides high-quality technical and regulatory expertise to industry and government to address a broad range of environmental issues. We specialize in solving complex environmental problems by leveraging our extensive knowledge of environmental regulations, stressing accurate data collection and analysis, and applying new technologies to our clients' most difficult challenges.

Responsibilities

Support environmental investigation projects by maintaining relational databases of environmental chemistry data from historical reports, laboratory test results, web sources, and third-party databases.
Build and maintain ETL (extract, transform, load) and analysis workflows in SQL, Python, and/or R to clean, transform, validate, and analyze environmental datasets.
Work with multi-disciplinary teams of engineers and scientists to support statistical and spatial analyses.
Build dashboards and visualizations, and format tables, charts, and graphs to style guidelines for technical reports and presentations.
Organize data in structures that support automation and downstream analysis.
Perform quality assurance on analytical databases to ensure data integrity, and identify and correct data gaps, errors, and relational table issues.
Support a wide variety of projects ranging from litigation support and site investigation to data mining for research and development.
Effectively communicate findings to internal and external clients.
Complete assigned tasks on schedule and within budget while meeting quality standards on deliverables.

Qualifications

BS/BA or higher degree in data science, computer science, statistics, environmental science, or a related field.
2-5 years of work experience in data management or analysis, with strong relational database skills using PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Access, or other database management systems.
Comfortable writing advanced SQL for data management (beyond basic create, read, update, delete), to clean, transform, and structure data in relational databases.
Familiarity with relational database design, data modeling, and normalization.
Awareness of data compilation, migration, and backup/retention considerations.
Shell scripting (Bash) and comfort working in Linux and command-line environments.
Experience using Python and/or R (Tidyverse, Shiny) for data analysis, visualization, dashboards, and web applications, including hands-on project work.
Self-motivated and eager to learn, with a drive to adopt new data and analysis techniques, AI, and emerging technologies to improve workflows.
Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines with limited supervision.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Additional preferred skillsets and qualifications include:
Familiarity with chemistry data, laboratory information management systems (LIMS), data validation, and extraction of data from online sources.
Version control (Git) and reproducible, scripted analysis workflows.
Application development and deployment, including web frameworks for data tools (e.g., Django, Flask/FastAPI, Dash, Streamlit, R Shiny). Familiarity with containerization (Docker) is a plus.
Experience with embedded and analytical database engines (e.g., SQLite, DuckDB) for local analysis, prototyping, and data interchange.

Job Perks

Competitive salary and benefits
Quarterly and year-end bonuses
Flexible work environment with potential for remote work
On-the-job training, mentorship, and professional development
Participation in conferences, technical presentations, and papers
Collaborative atmosphere
Base salary will vary depending on qualifications and experience.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $76,000–$110,000. This range represents GSI's good-faith estimate of the base salary for the position and is provided in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Starting salary will be determined based on several job-related factors, including relevant experience, education, professional licensure, certifications, technical expertise, geographic location, internal equity, and overall qualifications.

position leads a multifunctional project team to develop and execute Electric Power Systems product transfer projects utilizing the Collins Aerospace work transfer process defined in COL-PRO-0008. Transfer projects are typically between Collins Aerospace manufacturing sites (i.e. Make-to-Make) but can also be product insourcing and/or outsourcing projects (i.e. Buy-to-Make or Make-to-Buy). The Transition Project Manager will:

Lead a multifunctional project team to develop and execute product transition plans
Represent EPS business in transition risk assessments and gate reviews
Construct business cases for new product transfers
Track and report product transfer tasks including budget, schedule, risk mitigations and key actions to leadership
Work with project team to develop and deploy contingency plans and mitigation options for transition acceleration and / or recovery

Must be a U.S. Citizen

Aerospace product experience, EPS product experience is preferred
Procurement/Supply Chain experience with EPS product knowledge is preferred
CORE Apprentice is preferred
Project management experience, including risk, schedule, and budget management
SAP and / or material planning experience a plus

Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program

Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
And more!

Learn More & Apply Now!
